shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat AGENTS.md package.json tsconfig.json next.config.ts && for f in pages/* pages/blog/* pages/api/posts/* components/* styles/*; do if [ -f "$f" ]; then printf '"'\\n### %s\\n' \""'$f"; cat "$f"; fi; done'
/bin/bash -lc "node -v && npm -v && git diff -- package.json && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules/**'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' | sort"
/bin/bash -lc 'rg --files app components lib | sort && git status --short'
/bin/bash -lc "curl -sS http://localhost:3100/blog/1 | rg -o 'Comments.{0,100}|404 - Page Not Found|Something went wrong|Post 1|Back' | head -15"

/bin/bash -lc "git status --short && git diff --stat && git diff -- tsconfig.json styles/globals.css && rg -n 'next/router|next/head|next/document|getServerSideProps|getStaticProps|getStaticPaths|getInitialProps|NextApiRequest|NextApiResponse|router\\.isFallback|pages/' app components lib styles tsconfig.json next.config.ts || true"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .gitignore next-env.d.ts && du -sh .next tsconfig.tsbuildinfo && rg --files app components lib | sort'
